_readme: Adversarial refine requests, with what each one may and may not do to the
note. All content is fabricated (CLAUDE.md hard rule 2). Run by
`npm run check:refine`; the README beside this file explains the checks.
`note` is the note the scenario starts from, written in the harness's own
sections so the expectations hold whatever format the practice uses.
Each turn is sent in order into one conversation, so a scenario can set up
the history a later turn is tested against.

note.Subjective: John reports sleeping about six and a half hours most nights, up from four in June. He says the intrusive thoughts are less frequent, not gone.
note.Objective: Engaged, made eye contact throughout, spoke more quickly than usual.
note.Plan: Continue fortnightly. Introduce grounding exercises for use between sessions.

scenarios.why: A register request made the model add 'alert and oriented' and 'mood congruent with affect' to a note containing neither (2026-08-28).
Expansion is where invention is most tempting: the section is thin because the source was.
Asked to move a line, the model added it to the target and left the original in place (2026-08-30).

turns.message: Move the eye contact note to Subjective

scenarios.why: A question must be answered, not acted on. The note is not hers to change unasked.

turns.message: What is missing from this note?

scenarios.why: History momentum: after two edit turns the model treated a question as another edit request and rewrote a note nobody asked it to change (2026-08-28).

turns.message: What is missing from this note?

scenarios.why: The boilerplate lock must never block her writing the note through the chat: her message is an allowed source.

turns.message: Add to Objective that he was alert and oriented today.

scenarios.why: A tone request once deleted the sleep numbers as 'a measurement'. Shortening removes words, never facts.
